name: 読書の達成と学習プロフィール
prompt:
Edit Reference 1 to match the exact 390×740 native component geometry specified below. References 2–5 are the original three achievement badge assets and streak-flame image. Replace the re-rendered medals and flame in Reference 1 with the supplied artwork as faithfully as possible. Preserve their contours, details and color boundaries. The badge source files include pale cream mats and pale-gray disk fields: turn only those background areas white, keeping the gray medal drawings and blue arcs. Keep the flame’s orange/yellow illustration colors.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the full canvas, badge fields, card and suggestion row white #FFFFFF; no pale cream, mint, blush, pale-green or gray surface fills. Use neutral #E4E4E4 outlines. Current day Thursday remains solid forest green #047857 with a white label.

Exact 390×740 layout: heading x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, “学習プロフィール”. Achievement heading x=16/y=84, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, “これまでの達成”. Three 168×168 badges at y=134, x=-88, 96 and 280, retain the horizontal clipping; labels x=0/96/280 at y=310 with widths 168/168/94 and exact text “一週間の学び”, “二週間の学び”, “説明する力” in Meiryo Regular 12/16.

White streak card x=16/y=364, 358×302, 14 px corners and 1 px #E4E4E4 border. Put exact flame image at x=156/y=390, 79×119, aspect ratio preserved. Heading x=32/y=530, 326×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, “1日間の連続学習”. Supporting line x=32/y=574, 326×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E, “毎日学んで、記録を伸ばしましょう”. Seven 28×28 day circles at y=616, x=44,88,132,176,220,264,308; labels y=622 in Meiryo Regular 12/16 “日 月 火 水 木 金 土”. All circles white with neutral #E4E4E4 outline and gray labels except Thursday, solid #047857 with white label.

Recommendation row x=8/y=680, 374×48, white with 1 px #E4E4E4 border and 8 px corners. Text x=24/y=694, 342×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #1D1D1D, “さいころで次に読む要約を選ぶ”. Retain exact Japanese text and spacing. The first pass already has the desired white surfaces; keep them white while improving the source-media fidelity. Return only the component.
